name: Thor
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Thor keeps Westfall linked to Stormwind by gryphon flight. His trained mounts carry travelers and urgent messages above the dangerous roads.

sections.title: The Eyrie of Sentinel Hill
sections.body: Thor tends the gryphon roost at Sentinel Hill, linking Westfall's defenders with the rest of the kingdom. The People's Militia faces bandits, gnolls, and malfunctioning harvest golems on the ground. Thor's gryphons carry travelers and military dispatches above the perilous roads. Reports from Gryan Stoutmantle and urgent requests for aid can reach the court in Stormwind far faster than a ground messenger.

faq.answer: Thor is the human flight master at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He tends trained gryphons that carry travelers between Westfall and other Alliance settlements, including Stormwind City.

faq.q: What role does he play in Westfall?
faq.answer: Thor keeps Sentinel Hill connected by air. He coordinates couriers carrying military messages between the People's Militia and Stormwind's high command, so commanders can stay informed despite Defias activity on the roads.

faq.q: Why is gryphon travel important here?
faq.answer: Gryphon flights offer a swift, secure way around the dangerous roads between Westfall, Elwynn Forest, and Duskwood. Defias highwaymen, Riverpaw gnolls, and dangerous wildlife threaten those routes, while gryphons keep supplies and messages moving.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion helping the People's Militia, you can take Thor's quickest route back to the capital to deliver field intelligence and restock supplies.
